resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.org lists the site as Gone, while firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say Abandoned. None of the three dates the change, so the story reports both wordings and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: three short pages with a year, a status and a county row. No build detail, no design, no staffing, no description of the site now. Story body is 112 words. The last sentence (site condition today, and whether the public may visit) is deliberately unfootnoted: it states what the three pages do not say. Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site a hike-in, which the story reports with a footnote; the brief's access value (unknown) is therefore only partly supported, and no source says whether visitors may go there. Staffing is left out: the Idaho Fire Lookouts page says it has no documented staffing history. Location conflict in the brief is unresolved: the brief lists idaho_fl at 46.57521, -116.09338, about 0.9 km from the listing point 46.579, -116.083. The Idaho page read here has no coordinates, so that second position is unverified and not used. The Clearwater National Forest lookout list (fs.usda.gov/media/259185, June 2016) was checked in full text and has no Zelenka entry; it is not cited. Two WebSearch calls and one websearch.py call found no other Zelenka source. The 1925 date may be a record date rather than a build date; a human should check it against a primary source before publishing. Brief status (gone) and kind (unknown) hold up. The story was corrected in place on 2026-10-10: the 'no longer in use' inference was replaced with the sources' own terms (abandoned or gone), and the 1925 and 'only one that uses gone' sentences were tightened.
